Before he could regain his composure, HEV spoke calmly, almost cheerfully. 'You know, man, I kind of like that shit you put in me. Think you can get me some more?' Doc Miles tells him his flight is delayed. Chev curses. Doc Miles says the drugs they gave him are blocking his body’s ability to use adrenaline. Inside a microscopic view, chemicals dart and proteins shift. Doc Miles explains that ephedrine, produced in moments of fear or danger, normally binds to receptors to keep Chev alive. But an inhibitor in his system is stopping that process. His body can’t respond. That’s what’s killing him.

Pac-Man veers sharply, dodging the red ghost by a hair as it speeds past, then continues fleeing down the maze.

name: Pac-Man Flees Through Infinite Maze Amid Swarming Ghosts
description: Pac-Man darts through a narrow corridor, pursued by a red ghost. He veers down a passage, consuming a large dot. The red ghost turns blue, reverses direction, and flees. Pac-Man chases, closing in—until the ghost flashes back to red and sharply changes course, narrowly escaping. Pac-Man retreats, only to face another ghost at every turn. The camera pulls back in rapid succession, revealing the maze stretches endlessly in all directions. Thousands of ghosts advance from every corridor, surrounding him. The sound of the game surges, growing louder and more intense, filling the space with a relentless, pounding rhythm. Darkness falls. A single heartbeat pulses in the silence.

Pac-Man flees from a swarm of ghosts in an infinite maze
Game audio intensifies and becomes deafening

name: Chev Seeks Epinephrine at Pharmacy
description: Chev cuts in front of an old man using a walker and approaches the pharmacy counter. He runs his hand through his hair, trying to smooth it down. The pharmacist, a young woman with thick glasses, looks at him blankly. Chev says he needs something starting with 'E'—artificial adrenaline—for his heart problems. The pharmacist replies sarcastically, suggesting 'England,' then asks him to wait as she walks into the back room. Through the glass, Chev sees her pick up a phone. A teenager with greasy hair and acne, standing near the magazine rack, calls out, 'Nasal spray, dude.' He gestures toward a display of NAS-ALL bottles. 'It's got epinephrine in it. Get you tweaked, man.' Chev looks at the spray, then at the pharmacist on the phone watching him. He grabs several bottles from the display and leaves. As he passes, the old man gives him a sour look. Chev jerks suddenly toward him, making the man flinch.

Cue ball drops to sidewalk

name: The Brothers Chase Chev into the Street
description: The window of the building shatters outward as one of the Brothers is thrown against the frame, his arms thrust through the bars, one hand releasing a cue ball that drops to the sidewalk. A moment later, the door explodes off its hinges, and Chev is hurled through the opening, landing upside down in a heap of broken glass and splintered wood. The door crashes down on top of him. The Brothers burst out behind him, shouting as they pursue him into the street. Still gripping the pool cue, Chev stumbles to his car, scrambles inside, and peels away, speeding down the road as he laughs wildly, the sound fading into the distance.

name: Chev Escapes with Pool Cue in Hand
description: Chev stumbles toward his car, the pool cue clutched tightly in his hands. The Brothers shout and charge after him, but he swings the cue wildly, forcing them back. Glass from the shattered door clings to his clothes as he lunges for the vehicle, fumbles with the door, and throws himself inside. Tires screech as he speeds away, the cue still gripped in his white-knuckled hand.

name: Chev Flees in Car Amid Chaos
description: Chev stumbles to his car, yanks the door open, and throws himself inside. The engine roars as he peels out, tires screeching against the pavement. He accelerates down the street, swerving slightly, one hand gripping the wheel, the other still clutching the pool cue. Laughter bursts from him, wild and uncontrolled, as the car speeds away, leaving shattered glass and broken wood behind.

Chev laughs maniacally while heart pounds rapidly

name: Chev Chelios Calls the Answering Service
description: Chev Chelios dials the doctor’s number and reaches Chocolate, who answers at a cluttered desk in a run-down apartment. She wears a headset and takes a drag from her cigarette before responding in a flat, practiced tone. Chev demands to know where the doctor is. Confused, she replies that she doesn’t know—he’s not in the office. He presses harder, voice sharp with urgency. She offers to have the doctor paged. Chev relents, then issues a warning: if the doctor doesn’t call him back within the hour, he’s a dead man. He spells out his name—C-H-E-V, Chelios—and spells 'dead' clearly. Chocolate fumbles through the mess on her desk, searching for something to write with as she repeats the message back to him. He hangs up.

Chocolate searches for a writing instrument to record the message

name: Chev Chelios Fights to Stay Conscious in Car
description: After hanging up the phone, Chev Chelios slumps in the driver's seat, his eyes heavy as he begins to nod off. Inside his chest, his heart beats slower—LUB DUB, LUB DUB—each pulse deep and sluggish. The camera slips beneath his skin, revealing the organ dimming like a failing engine. Suddenly, his foot presses down on the gas. The car surges forward, and the jolt races through his body. Adrenaline floods his system, his heart hammering faster—LUBDUB, LUBDUB, LUBDUB—light flaring back into his eyes. He gasps, snapping awake, his face tightening with focus as he grabs his cell phone and plugs it into the cigarette lighter.

As he drifts in and out of consciousness, Doc Miles speaks to him over the phone, urgently instructing him to get to an emergency room for epinephrine—an artificial form of adrenaline—administered in 10 milligram syringes. He warns Chev that the drug is potent and advises using only a fifth of an injection. Struggling to focus, Chev repeats the name 'epinephrine' aloud, trying to lock in the information. Mid-conversation, his head suddenly lolls forward and he bangs it against the steering wheel. Doc Miles asks if he understood, and Chev responds weakly. His phone beeps, signaling another call, and he disconnects without warning.

Chev hangs up without responding. A moment later, Kaylo calls back. Chev answers but says nothing. Kaylo repeats that he saw Verona's brother go into the restaurant two minutes earlier while he was getting a taco across the street. Chev asks where Kaylo is now. Bodyguards move across the deck, and a woman lies sunbathing nearby. He sets the cigar down, stands, and dives into the pool. He swims underwater toward the surface, where a distorted figure appears above, looking down. Suddenly, a man jumps in fully dressed—Chev. He meets Carlito beneath the water and points upward. They rise together, breaking the surface. Several bodyguards stand at the edge, guns drawn. Carlito raises a hand, and they lower their weapons.

Armed bodyguards line the pool's edge, weapons drawn, as Carlito calms them with a gesture. The two men tread water, their heads just above the surface, speaking urgently.

name: Carlito Tells Chev There's No Antidote
description: Carlito and Chev tread water in the rooftop pool, their heads barely above the surface. Bodyguards line the edge, weapons in hand, watching silently. Carlito tells Chev the poison in his system is the kind used on horses—lethal, with no antidote. Chev stares at him, stunned. He asks if that’s it, if there’s nothing that can be done. Carlito says he should already be dead, that it’s a miracle he’s still alive. Chev struggles to process the news, anger rising. He demands to know if Carlito will hunt down Verona and his crew. Carlito doesn’t answer. He shrugs, saying Verona is a small-time punk, but the situation might present an opportunity. Chev reacts with disbelief, then fury, shouting that he’s having a difficult day. Carlito looks at him, quiet, then asks if he’s being disrespectful.

Chev confronts Carlito about the lack of an antidote

name: Carlito Sees Opportunity in Chev's Desperation
description: Carlito floats in the pool, calm and composed, as Chev struggles to stay afloat beside him. Chev pleads for help, demanding an antidote for the poison he’s been given. Carlito tells him there is none, that the substance was meant for horses, and that Chev should already be dead. When Chev urges him to retaliate against Verona and his crew, Carlito dismisses Verona as a small-time punk. He then suggests that Chev’s situation could serve a larger purpose—balancing the scales after the Don Kim hit, which brought unexpected heat from Hong Kong. Chev reacts with disbelief and anger, shouting that his death shouldn’t be used as leverage. Carlito remains unmoved, his expression unreadable as the two tread water under the watchful eyes of armed bodyguards.
related_events: Carlito expresses regret but sees strategic opportunity in Chev's condition
Carlito acknowledges Chev's urgent news

name: Chev Confronts Carlito in the Pool
description: Chev stares at Carlito, his breath ragged in the water. The sound of their treading legs fills the silence. 'Well you don't have to be so damn cool about it,' Chev says. Carlito shrugs. 'What do you expect me to do?' Chev's voice rises. 'Tell me you're going to find that punk Verona and his whole fuckin' crew and feed `em to a cage of wolverines.' Carlito doesn't respond. Chev leans in. 'What is this? Are you boys now or something?' Carlito says Verona is a small-time punk, but there might be an opportunity—this could even the score for the Don Kim hit. 'Ill-advised,' Carlito calls it. Chev stares, stunned. 'Ill advised? I'm glad to know that my death can be of some use to you.' Carlito tells him not to be difficult. 'Am I being difficult?' Chev snaps. 'Is this what you call difficult? I don't know if you noticed, but I'm having a DIFFICULT FUCKING DAY, BRO!' The word hangs in the air. Carlito's expression shifts. 'Are you disrespecting...'

Carlito questions Chev's disrespect during tense underwater conversation

One of his bodyguards steps forward, hand reaching for a weapon, but Carlito raises a finger and the man stops. Carlito does not speak. He floats slightly, treading water, eyes fixed on Chev as he storms off the rooftop without looking back.

name: Verona Taunts Unconscious Chev with a Poisoned Warning
description: Ricky Verona sits on Chev's bed, speaking directly into a camera pointed at him. Chev lies unconscious behind him, pale in the dim light filtering through the blinds. Hooded figures linger around the room. Verona smirks, addressing Chev as a 'douchebag' and announcing that he's dead. He explains that instead of tearing him apart, he chose to poison him in his sleep—some kind of synthetic Chinese toxin that’s already bound to his blood. As Verona speaks, the sound of Chev’s heartbeat begins to grow louder and faster, though Chev remains out of focus. Verona mocks the idea of trying to vomit it up, insisting it’s useless. He describes the symptoms—stiff joints, difficulty breathing, a slowing heart—and points to the camera, telling Chev he’s on candid camera and to not embarrass himself. One of the thugs, Alex, chimes in with a singsong line about the Scarecrow, which Verona dismisses. The thugs laugh. One steps forward and kisses Chev on the head. Verona finishes by reminding Chev that this is payback for killing Don Kim, then tells him to have a nice death before the recording ends.

name: Chev Wakes to Verona's Taunt

The sound of Chev’s heartbeat begins to rise in volume and speed. Chev stirs, his eyes fluttering open. From his point of view, he looks around the room, disoriented and alarmed. The heartbeat grows louder, more urgent. Verona continues his taunt, describing the effects of the poison—stiffening joints, difficulty breathing. Chev clutches the left side of his chest, feeling his pulse. The rhythm falters, slows. He drops to his knees, shoves a finger into his mouth, and gags, trying to vomit. Verona laughs, telling him it’s useless. One of the thugs in the room steps forward and kisses the top of Chev’s head. Verona finishes the recording, smirking, and the phone keeps ringing in the background.

name: Chev Confronts Orlando in the Bathroom
description: Chev forces Orlando into a bathroom at gunpoint, shoving him against the wall and pressing a Glock .45 to his forehead. He demands to know where Verona is, his voice wild and urgent. Orlando, trying to stay calm, calls out through the door to a biker banging from the outside, saying there's a white man with a gun and asking for no sudden moves. The door bursts open as several armed men crowd in, weapons drawn, creating a tense standoff in the cramped space. Orlando shouts over the chaos that the white man is cool, urging everyone to calm down. He speaks in a steady voice, suggesting they talk things through. Chev keeps the gun aimed at Orlando’s head, demanding again to know Verona’s location. Orlando insists he’s not working with Verona, claiming Verona actually owes him seventy-five thousand dollars. Chev remains skeptical, pressing closer, the tension flaring once more.

name: Chev Threatens to Kill Orlando
description: Chev presses the gun harder against Orlando's forehead and shouts, demanding to know where Ricky Verona is. He shoves Orlando against the wall and screams that he will blow his brains into the toilet if he doesn't get answers. The door bursts open as six armed men crowd into the bathroom, weapons drawn, filling the small space with chaos. Guns point in every direction, bodies jostle, and voices shout over one another, the room teetering on the edge of violence. Orlando yells for calm, declaring that the white man is cool, and slowly the noise subsides. He speaks in a steady voice, urging everyone to talk things through. Chev keeps the gun fixed on Orlando, his breath heavy. Orlando says he has no connection to Ricky Verona, claims Verona betrayed him on the Anselmo job, and insists Verona owes him seventy-five thousand dollars. Chev refuses to believe it, pressing closer, the tension flaring again as the men around them tense, ready for conflict.

name: Chev Lowers His Gun and Collapses
description: Chev stares at Orlando, then slowly lowers the gun. The Brothers mutter among themselves, lowering their weapons with hesitation. Orlando exhales, his voice calm. 'Appreciate it. We keep it civil, we keep it clean.' Chev sways on his feet, his face pale, sweat beading on his forehead. He stumbles, his knees buckling, and one of the Brothers steps forward quickly, grabbing his arm to keep him from hitting the floor. Orlando watches, his expression shifting as Chev sags, breathing hard, barely conscious.

name: Chev Snorts Cocaine to Survive
description: Chev, weak and collapsing, pleads with Orlando for cocaine, insisting he needs it to stay alive. Orlando mocks him, refusing at first, insulted by the request. Chev insists, explaining his condition is life-threatening. He pulls out cash and hands it over. Orlando takes the money and tosses a bag of cocaine toward him, but it sticks to Chev’s sweaty forehead before falling to the floor. Chev drops to his knees, unable to catch it, and crawls forward, snorting the drug from the ground in a frantic, desperate motion. The Brothers in the room laugh at the sight. Orlando watches, visibly disgusted. For a moment, nothing happens. Then Chev’s heart begins to race. His breathing sharpens. He suddenly surges upward, pounding his chest, shouting that it’s working, alive again with jolted energy.
